mapper.update: UPDATE sa_document SET status=#{status},progress=#{progress},chunk_count=#{chunkCount},current_task_id=#{currentTaskId},error_message=NULL,processed_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='FAILED'

UPDATE sa_document SET status=#{status}, progress=#{progress}, chunk_count=COALESCE(#{chunkCount},chunk_count), error_message=#{errorMessage}, processed_at=CASE WHEN #{ready}=true THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE processed_at END WHERE id=#{id} AND current_task_id=#{taskId} AND status IN ('UPLOADED','PARSING','CHUNKING','EMBEDDING')
mapper.select: SELECT storage_key FROM sa_document WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{knowledgeBaseId} AND user_id=#{userId}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sa_document WHERE storage_key=#{storageKey})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sa_document WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId}
